unlisted_practices: Normalizing LLM-extracted EHR variables to FHIR and OHDSI vocabularies
Retrieval-augmented checklist extraction with evidence justifications and source-document citations
Iterative error analysis with automated consistency checks for LLM data extraction

screen.reason: The study develops and evaluates LLM-based information extraction pipelines (including RAG and schema extraction) on oncology EHR records. Although it incorporates automated checks and citations into the tool architecture, it benchmarks model extraction performance rather than testing an organizational deployment safeguard or comparing outcomes with/without a deployment practice.
